Privacy Notice
Effective Date: October 21, 2026
This Privacy Notice describes how Block, Inc. and our affiliates (collectively, “Block,” “we,” and “us”) collect, use, disclose, transfer, store, retain or otherwise process your information when you interact with the dessa.com website (the “Services”).This Privacy Notice applies only to information collected in connection with your access to and use of our Services. Please read this Privacy Notice carefully. By continuing to interact with our Services, you are consenting to the practices described in this Privacy Notice.
This privacy notice does not cover the processing of your information when using other Block websites, products, or services, such as Square, Cash App, Afterpay, or TIDAL. Each of these offerings is governed by its own applicable privacy notice.
We may also include links to other websites, including social media platforms. For example, you may be given the option to share a news or blog article on a social media platform. This privacy notice does not apply to the data processing practices of other websites, and we encourage you to read the privacy notices available on any other website you visit.
Additionally, this privacy notice does not cover information processed about candidates for employment or contractual services. For details on privacy practices related to employment or contractual candidates, please click here.
INFORMATION WE COLLECT ABOUT YOU
We collect information about you when you interact with the Services or or when you voluntarily choose to provide information to us directly.
Information You Provide
We collect information from you, including:
- Identification Information. Your name; email address; mailing address; and phone number.  
- Other Information You Provide. Information that you voluntarily provide to us, including correspondence with us, or any other actions performed on the Services.
Information We Collect Automatically from Your Use of our Services
We collect information about you and the devices you use to access the Services, such as your computer, mobile phone, or tablet. The information that we collect includes:
- Device information. Information about your device, including your hardware model, operating system and version, device name, unique device identifier, mobile network information, and information about the device’s interaction with our Services.  
- Internet or other electronic network activity information. Information about how you use and interact with our Services, including your access time, browser type and language, country and language setting on your device, Internet Protocol (“IP”) address, the domain name of your internet service provider, other attributes about your browser, mobile device and operating system, features you use, and the date and time of your visit to or use of the Services.
SOURCES OF INFORMATION
We only collect (and/or have collected during at least the 12-month period preceding the effective date of this Privacy Notice) information directly from you, and from how you use our Services. 
HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
We may collect, use and share (or have collected, used or shared during at least the 12-month period preceding the effective date of this Privacy Notice), information about you for the following reasons:
Providing, Improving, and Developing our Services
- Determining whether the Services are available in your country;  
- Providing, maintaining, and improving our Services;  
- Developing new products and services;  
- Delivering the information and support you request;  
- Improving, personalizing, and facilitating your use of our Services;  
- Measuring, tracking, and analyzing trends and usage in connection with your use or the performance of our Services; and  
- Otherwise providing you with the products and features you choose to use.
Communicating with You About our Services
- Sending you surveys and getting your feedback about our Services; and  
- Sending you information we think you may find useful or which you have requested from us about our products, services and other company updates, such as when you sign up for investor email alerts.
Protecting our Services and Maintaining a Trusted Environment
- Conducting investigations, complying with and enforcing any applicable laws, regulations, legal requirements, and industry standards, and responding to lawful requests for information from the government or to valid legal process;  
- Contacting you to resolve disputes and help you with our Services;  
- Debugging to identify and fix errors that impair how our Services function;  
- Enforcing our Terms of Service or other applicable agreements or policies;  
- Investigating, detecting, preventing, recovering from, or reporting fraud, misrepresentations, security breaches or incidents, or other potentially prohibited, malicious, or illegal activities;  
- Protecting our, or your rights or property, or the security or integrity of our Services;  
- Verifying or maintaining the quality and safety of our Services; and  
- Verifying your identity.
Other Uses
- For any other reason we may tell you about from time to time.
WHEN AND WITH WHOM WE SHARE YOUR INFORMATION
We may share the information described in the “Information We Collect About You” section with the following categories of service providers and third parties:
With our Affiliates and Group Companies
- With our group companies and corporate affiliates, such as Cash App, Square, Afterpay, or TIDAL, for the reasons outlined above. For example, we may share your information internally to understand how you engage with Block company products to help make our Services better for you and for everyone, and to help us build Services tailored to your preferences.
With Our Service Providers
- With service providers who help us to provide, maintain, and improve our Services, including service providers who access information about you to perform services on our behalf (e.g., vendors who help us with fraud prevention, identity verification, and fee collection services), and other entities that help us provide the Services.
Business Transfers and Corporate Changes
- To a subsequent owner, co-owner, or operator of one or more of the Services; or  
- If we do or try to do a corporate merger, consolidation, or restructuring (including during due diligence and negotiation of these); the sale of substantially all of our stock and/or assets; the financing, acquisition, divestiture, or dissolution of all or a portion of our business; or other corporate change.
Safety and Compliance with Law
- If we believe that disclosure is reasonably necessary (i) to comply with any applicable law, regulation, legal process or governmental request (e.g., from creditors, tax authorities, law enforcement agencies, in response to a garnishment, levy, or lien notice, etc.); (ii) to establish, exercise or defend our legal rights; (iii) to enforce or comply with our Terms of Service or other applicable agreements or policies; (iv) to protect our or our customers’ rights or property, or the security or integrity of our Services; (v) for an investigation of suspected or actual illegal activity; or (vi) to protect us, users of our Services, or the public from harm, fraud, or potentially prohibited or illegal activities.
With Your Consent
With your consent. For example:
- At your direction or as described at the time you agree to share; or  
- When you authorize a third party application or website to access your information.
With Others
- With other companies who deliver services on our behalf, including via the use of cookies and similar automated technologies.
Aggregated and Anonymized Information
- We also may share (within our group of companies or affiliates, or with service providers or other third parties) aggregated and anonymized information that does not specifically identify you or any individual user of our Services.

report.summary: Block 推出 Dessa，号称史上最真实的全双工语音模型
report.background: （注：本次抓取到的页面正文只有隐私声明，以下内容依据标题及公开信息整理，具体参数请以官方发布为准。）长期以来，语音助手基本采用“半双工”模式：用户说完后系统才开始识别，回复完再交还话筒，对话因此有对讲机式的机械感。2024 年 OpenAI 展示实时语音后，“全双工”成为语音 AI 的核心竞争点：模型需要边说边听、能被打断、能自然接话。Block（Jack Dorsey 旗下、Square 与 Cash App 母公司）近年持续加码 AI，曾开源 agent 框架 Goose；Dessa 是其自研语音模型，主打拟人化的对话真实感，瞄准商家服务等真实业务场景。
key_points: 全双工架构：模型可以同时听和说，用户不必等它讲完就能插话，被打断后也能自然地接上。
副语言细节：加入“嗯”“对”这类附和、笑声、吸气与语气词，还原真人对话中的“不完美”。
轮次切换更自然：减少传统语音助手的固定等待和机械停顿，让对话节奏接近真人。
归属 Block：Dessa 由支付公司 Block 自研，方向偏向客服、商家助手等落地场景，不以实验室演示为目标。
竞争定位：它直接对标 OpenAI 实时语音等全双工方案，比拼的是真实感，而不只是响应速度。
report.impact: 对行业：语音交互正从“轮流说话”转向“同时对话”，实时语音模型的竞争焦点从延迟转向自然度和情绪表达。对开发者：是否开放 API、延迟与成本如何，将决定它能否进入客服、陪伴、智能硬件等产品。对普通用户：与 AI 通话将越来越像与人聊天，但“听不出是机器”也会带来身份披露、录音合规与信任问题。
report.tools: 想上手可关注开源全双工语音项目 Moshi（Kyutai）、Freeze-Omni，以及做实时语音编排的 LiveKit Agents、Pipecat、Ultravox；若关注 Block 生态，可看其开源 agent 框架 Goose。
